title: Canaoaves & Admin Canaoaves
subtitle: Collaborative Birdwatching Platform in Brazil
summary: National Registry of Birdwatchers. React/Vite SPA hosted on Vercel with Serverless Supabase PostgreSQL backend, RLS Bypass, and Views. (www.canaoaves.com.br)
overview: Canaoaves is Brazil's central collaborative platform for registering birdwatchers, scientific expeditions, species sightings, and conservation events.
roleDescription: Lead Architect and Full-Stack Developer for both public SPA and administrative portal.
responsibilities: Designed single page application in React, TypeScript, Vite, and Tailwind CSS hosted on Vercel.
Modeled Supabase PostgreSQL relational database schema with Row Level Security (RLS) policies for user data isolation.
Engineered serverless admin bypass architecture using database Views and service role functions for global analytics.
Integrated dynamic species filter, interactive location maps, and media upload features.

challengesAndSolutions.challenge: Bypassing Row Level Security (RLS) policies safely in administrative dashboards without exposing private user data to client bundles.
challengesAndSolutions.solution: Created SECURITY DEFINER database functions and PostgreSQL Views exposing aggregated data via isolated serverless calls.

metrics: Serving thousands of birdwatchers across Brazil with zero server infrastructure maintenance costs
100% serverless deployment with Vercel and Supabase
